fidelity: F2a — Asymmetric Hybrid Physics-Lumped Model with Thermal ODE
source: Conway (1999) Electrochemical Supercapacitors; Omar et al. (2015) IEEE Trans. Ind. Electron. 62(10):6738-6745 (LIC characterization); Soltani & Beheshti (2021) J. Energy Storage 34:102019 (LIC review); Firouz & Van Mierlo (2017) Electrochim. Acta 256 (LIC ECM)

unit.name: Generic 2200F Lithium-Ion Capacitor Cell — Asymmetric (LTO/graphite faradaic anode + activated-carbon EDLC cathode)

Q_max.note: Usable charge capacity over 2.2-3.8 V window (~1.22 Ah)

C_dl.note: Double-layer capacitance of activated-carbon (EDLC) electrode branch

f_far.note: Fraction of terminal voltage swing carried by the faradaic (battery-type) OCV branch; rest is EDLC. Soltani & Beheshti (2021)

V_max.note: Maximum cell voltage (Omar et al. 2015 LIC upper limit)

V_min.note: Minimum cell voltage — faradaic plateau floor (sloping LIC, not 0 V like EDLC)

R_esr.note: Equivalent series resistance (1.1 mOhm, Omar et al. 2015)

R_leak.note: Parallel leakage/self-discharge resistance (low for hybrid vs ideal cap)

k_far.note: Curvature coefficient of the Nernst-like faradaic OCV term

cp_cell.note: Lumped specific heat capacity of cell

hA_amb.note: Convective heat-transfer coefficient * surface area to ambient

alpha_R.note: ESR temperature coefficient (ESR falls with rising T)
